entries.title: Sodium benzoate (E211)
entries.why: A common preservative. Under some conditions it can form benzene with ascorbic acid (vitamin C). Regulators set an acceptable daily intake; some people report sensitivity.

entries.title: Sodium nitrite (E250)
entries.why: Used in cured meats to prevent botulism and fix color. Can contribute to nitrosamine formation; many public-health authorities advise limiting processed meat intake.
sources: IARC classifications related to processed meat (context)

entries.title: Monosodium glutamate (E621)
entries.why: Flavour enhancer. Generally recognized as safe at normal use levels by major regulators; a minority of people report sensitivity. Listed for transparency, not as a high-hazard additive.
sources: FDA / JECFA public positions on MSG (summarized)
